title: The Hidden Burden of Mortality Across ICD-10 Conditions in Australia: Multiple Cause of Death Analysis Code and Derived Data
description: Analysis code and derived datasets for a cross-sectional multiple cause of death analysis quantifying the hidden burden of mortality across all ICD-10 three-character conditions in Australia, using the crude multiple-to-underlying ratio. Accompanies the manuscript submitted to Discover Public Health and the medRxiv preprint. Pre-registered on the Open Science Framework.
